# mangacn

> 100 shadcn/ui registry items that redraw shadcn in a manga style (ink, paper, screentone) with one accent colour, a dark mode (the negative of the page) and right-to-left reading order. MIT. Installed with the shadcn CLI straight from GitHub.

Install any item: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/<item>`
Every item depends on `Romcharted/mangacn/base` (tokens, screentone utilities, animations), installed automatically.
Restyled shadcn components install to `@ui/manga/<name>.tsx` and wrap the project's own `@/components/ui/<name>` (works with Radix and Base UI).
Homepage: https://romcharted.github.io/mangacn

## Items

### Manga base (`base`)

Shared foundation for every mangacn item: ink/paper tokens mapped onto shadcn variables (dark mode is the negative) and one accent colour, --mg-accent (stamp red by default; presets via data-accent="indigo|pine|ochre"), which also drives --destructive. Screentone utilities (tone-10/20/35/50, tone-lines, tone-cross, tone-fade-r/l/t/b, tone-frame), on-tone (paper plate for labels over tones), knockout (outline for heavy SFX), speed-lines and focus-lines, tone-shadow (offset screentone, never a blur), ink-fill, focus-ink, border-ink, shape-burst, edge-jagged, mark-error, a reading-rtl: variant for manga reading order (data-reading="rtl"), a screentone veil for every shadcn overlay, and stepped 12 fps animations. Installed automatically as a dependency of every other item. Includes stepped keyframes for tabs, clicks, switches, dialogs and toasts; all motion stops with prefers-reduced-motion.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/base`
- Categories: foundations

```tsx
<div className="relative border-ink tone-shadow p-6">
  <div className="tone-fade-b h-24" />
  <h2 className="on-tone font-letter text-2xl">Chapter 1</h2>
</div>
```

### Font: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (`font-body`)

Reading face for body text and form fields (SIL OFL). Sets --font-manga-body. Installed by base.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/font-body`
- Categories: foundations

### Font: Patrick Hand SC (`font-lettering`)

Hand-lettering face for titles, buttons and badges (SIL OFL). Sets --font-manga-letter. Installed by base.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/font-lettering`
- Categories: foundations

### Font: Dela Gothic One (`font-sfx`)

Very heavy face for onomatopoeia, covers Latin and katakana (SIL OFL). Sets --font-manga-sfx. Installed by base.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/font-sfx`
- Categories: foundations

### Gestures (`gestures`)

The JavaScript half of the mangacn grammar: punch() and withImpact() play the G4 impact on click or keyboard validation (data-impact for ~250 ms), <ImpactLines> draws the short speed lines outside the element, <FocusFlash> draws an optional halo of concentration lines around a window as it opens (G5, never full screen). Everything is skipped with prefers-reduced-motion.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/gestures`
- Categories: foundations
- Props:
  - `punch(el)`: `(el: Element) => void` — Plays the three-frame impact on an element.
  - `withImpact(handler)`: `(handler?) => handler` — Wraps a click handler so it also plays the impact.
  - `<ImpactLines offset>`: `"normal" | "far"` (default `"normal"`) — Speed lines on both sides; "far" for bursts.
  - `<FocusFlash />`: `component` — Optional halo of concentration lines around a window as it opens.

```tsx
import { ImpactLines, withImpact } from "@/lib/manga/gestures"

<button className="relative data-[impact]:animate-hit" onClick={withImpact(onSave)}>
  Save
  <ImpactLines />
</button>
```

### Button (`button`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Button. Variants: default (ink flat), outline, tone (screentone band on the bottom third, label on paper), ghost, link (wavy underline that thickens on hover), destructive (accent colour, jagged edge), shout (burst shape for the one call to action on a page; its focus ring is a second burst). Sizes sm, default, lg, icon. Hover: a screentone shadow appears. Pressed: 2px offset and a negative that stays visible in dark mode. Disabled: dashed line, tone frame, label on paper. Adds loading (concentration lines turning in steps, aria-busy) and fullWidth. A click plays a three-frame impact (negative, recoil, settle) with short speed lines on both sides; the shout burst fidgets on hover.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/button`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"default" | "outline" | "tone" | "ghost" | "link" | "destructive" | "shout"` (default `"default"`) — Visual style.
  - `size`: `"sm" | "default" | "lg" | "icon"` (default `"default"`) — Height and padding.
  - `loading`: `boolean` (default `false`) — Shows turning focus lines, sets aria-busy and aria-disabled and ignores clicks, but stays focusable (focus never drops to the page).
  - `fullWidth`: `boolean` (default `false`) — Stretches to the container width.

```tsx
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/manga/button"

<Button variant="shout" size="lg">Start!</Button>
<Button variant="outline" loading>Saving</Button>
```

### Input (`input`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Input. 2px ink line that thickens to 3px on focus, italic placeholder, fine line when read-only, dashed line + light tone when disabled, and an error look on aria-invalid (stamp red, serrated bottom edge, "!" mark). Sizes via inputSize: sm, default, lg.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/input`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `inputSize`: `"sm" | "default" | "lg"` (default `"default"`) — Height and text size.
  - `aria-invalid`: `boolean` — Shows the error look.

```tsx
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/manga/input"

<Input placeholder="Pen name" />
<Input aria-invalid defaultValue="reader@" />
```

### Select (`select`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Select. The trigger is drawn like Input with a brush chevron that turns in two steps. The list is a case (3px ink line, tone shadow) with a notch toward the trigger, popping in over three frames. The highlighted option inverts to ink; the chosen option gets a brush check that draws itself. Group labels are underlined lettering; disabled options keep the label with a dashed underline. Adds SelectEmpty (a “…” mark) and SelectLoading (turning concentration lines).

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/select`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `SelectEmpty`: `component` — Empty list: a “…” mark and a short line.
  - `SelectLoading`: `component` — While options load: turning concentration lines.
  - `aria-invalid`: `boolean` — On SelectTrigger: the error look.

```tsx
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/manga/select"

<Select>
  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="Pick a volume" /></SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="v1">Vol. 1</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="v2">Vol. 2</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

### Checkbox (`checkbox`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Checkbox. Square ink box; hover thickens the line (no screentone under 24px); checked is an ink flat with a brush check that draws itself in three frames; indeterminate is a thick bar; disabled is dashed; aria-invalid uses the accent colour.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/checkbox`
- Categories: actions

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/manga/checkbox"

<label className="flex items-center gap-3">
  <Checkbox defaultChecked /> Notify me
</label>
```

### Switch (`switch`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Switch, 44 × 24 px. Off: paper track and ink thumb. On: ink track and paper thumb. Hover thickens the line, disabled is dashed, aria-invalid uses the accent colour. The thumb travels in three steps with a trail of speed lines; a small spark flies off when it turns on.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/switch`
- Categories: actions

```tsx
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/manga/switch"

<Switch defaultChecked />
```

### Badge (`badge`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Badge in lettering type. Variants: default (ink flat), outline, tone (screentone tab at the start, label on paper), destructive (clean accent flat), burst ("NEW!" star) and stamp (tilted accent stamp). Optional square status dot; icons via data-icon.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/badge`
- Categories: feedback
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"default" | "outline" | "tone" | "destructive" | "burst" | "stamp"` (default `"default"`) — Visual style.
  - `dot`: `boolean` (default `false`) — Square status dot before the label.

```tsx
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/manga/badge"

<Badge variant="burst">New!</Badge>
<Badge variant="outline" dot>Live</Badge>
```

### Skeleton (`skeleton`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Skeleton: a light screentone (tone-10) that flickers in steps instead of pulsing in opacity, no heavy frame. Shapes: text, avatar, panel, block. SkeletonCard composes a card placeholder.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/skeleton`
- Categories: feedback
- Props:
  - `shape`: `"text" | "avatar" | "panel" | "block"` (default `"block"`) — Preset size and frame.

```tsx
import { Skeleton, SkeletonCard } from "@/components/ui/manga/skeleton"

<Skeleton shape="text" />
<SkeletonCard />
```

### Toast (Sonner) (`sonner`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Sonner Toaster: 3px panel with an offset second frame, stepped entrance, lettering titles, ink marks for success / info / warning / error, concentration lines while loading, a shake on error. ToastSfx adds an onomatopoeia in its own column. ToastCard renders a static toast with the same look for previews and docs. Toasts enter in three steps with motion lines under them.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/sonner`
- Categories: feedback

```tsx
import { Toaster, toast, ToastSfx } from "@/components/ui/manga/sonner"

<Toaster />

toast.success("Subscribed!")
toast("Level up!", { icon: <ToastSfx>DON!</ToastSfx> })
```

### Card (`card`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Card as a comic panel: 3px frame and an offset screentone shadow. Variants: default, bleed (first image runs to the edges), tilted (slanted bottom edge drawn in SVG; the content stays upright), splash (focus lines around a wide empty centre, title on a paper plate), beta (ink flat). interactive lifts it on hover; selected adds a double ink frame.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/card`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"default" | "bleed" | "tilted" | "splash" | "beta"` (default `"default"`) — Panel style.
  - `interactive`: `boolean` (default `false`) — Hover lift and longer shadow.
  - `selected`: `boolean` (default `false`) — Double ink frame.

```tsx
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/card"

<Card variant="tilted">
  <CardHeader><CardTitle>Chapter 12</CardTitle></CardHeader>
  <CardContent>The long night.</CardContent>
</Card>
```

### Tabs (`tabs`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Tabs. Variants: index (tabs resting on the 3px top edge of a framed panel, the active tab merges with the panel), underline (one baseline, a thick bar under the active tab), boxed (one frame split into cells, the active cell is an ink flat). The flat or bar travels to the new tab in three steps and the panel slides in. Labels always sit on paper. Horizontal and vertical; disabled tabs are dashed with a tone frame.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/tabs`
- Categories: navigation
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"index" | "underline" | "boxed"` (default `"index"`) — Set on <Tabs>; lists and triggers follow.

```tsx
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/tabs"

<Tabs variant="index" defaultValue="v1">
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="v1">Vol. 1</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="v2">Vol. 2</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="v1">…</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
```

### Table (`table`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Table. The table sits in a case; the header is an ink flat and stays in place while the body scrolls (maxHeight). Rows are split by a 1px line, never striped. Hovered row: a 3px ink bar at the row start; selected row (data-state="selected" or aria-selected): a 6px bar. Sortable headers get a brush arrow and aria-sort. Adds TableEmpty (a “…” mark) and TableLoading (flickering tone placeholders).

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/table`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `maxHeight`: `string` — On Table: height of the scroll area; the header stays in place.
  - `sort`: `"ascending" | "descending" | "none"` — On TableHead: sortable column with a brush arrow (sets aria-sort).
  - `onSort`: `() => void` — On TableHead: called when the arrow button is pressed.
  - `TableEmpty / TableLoading`: `{ colSpan }` — Empty and loading rows.

```tsx
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/manga/table"

<Table>
  <TableHeader>
    <TableRow><TableHead sort="ascending">Title</TableHead><TableHead>Pages</TableHead></TableRow>
  </TableHeader>
  <TableBody>
    <TableRow data-state="selected"><TableCell>The long night</TableCell><TableCell>24</TableCell></TableRow>
  </TableBody>
</Table>
```

### Accordion (`accordion`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Accordion. Items are cases stacked so they share their lines; the open header is an ink flat that sweeps in, the content drops in by steps and the brush chevron turns in two steps. Hover thickens the label underline; disabled items keep the label on paper inside a tone frame. Radix needs type="single" | "multiple" on <Accordion>; Base UI does not.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/accordion`
- Categories: display

```tsx
import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/accordion"

<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem value="a">
    <AccordionTrigger>Chapter 1</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>The long night.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

### Dialog (`dialog`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Dialog: centred 3px panel with a screentone shadow that pops in over three steps; the overlay is a light screentone fixed to the screen (no blur, no moiré when zooming). Sizes sm, default, lg, full. DialogBody adds a scrolling region that keeps the shadow outside. flash adds a halo of concentration lines around the window as it opens (off by default).

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/dialog`
- Categories: overlays
- Props:
  - `size`: `"sm" | "default" | "lg" | "full"` (default `"default"`) — On DialogContent: max width.
  - `flash`: `boolean` (default `false`) — On DialogContent: a halo of concentration lines around the window as it opens.

```tsx
import { Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/manga/dialog"

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger>Open</DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent size="sm"><DialogTitle>Leave the chapter?</DialogTitle></DialogContent>
</Dialog>
```

### Tooltip (`tooltip`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Tooltip as a mini speech bubble with a curved tail (or two circles for thought) that follows the side; the offset leaves room for the tail. TooltipBubble renders a static bubble for previews and docs.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/tooltip`
- Categories: overlays
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"speech" | "thought"` (default `"speech"`) — On TooltipContent.

```tsx
import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/tooltip"

<Tooltip>
  <TooltipTrigger>Hover me</TooltipTrigger>
  <TooltipContent variant="thought">Maybe tomorrow.</TooltipContent>
</Tooltip>
```

### Speech Bubble (`speech-bubble`)

Manga speech bubble drawn in SVG at its real size and inscribed in its box, with real text inside. Variants: speech, thought (cloud), shout (spikes), whisper (dashed), narration (caption box), electronic (zigzag), wobbly (trembling). The tail points to top, bottom, start or end, aligned start/center/end, or none, and its room is reserved as margin. BubbleGroup chains bubbles through a neck that hides both outlines.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/speech-bubble`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"speech" | "thought" | "shout" | "whisper" | "narration" | "electronic" | "wobbly"` (default `"speech"`) — Bubble shape.
  - `tail`: `"top" | "bottom" | "start" | "end" | "none"` (default `"bottom"`) — Side the tail points to.
  - `tailAlign`: `"start" | "center" | "end"` (default `"start"`) — Tail position along that side.
  - `seed`: `number` (default `7`) — Seed for hand-drawn irregularities.

```tsx
import { SpeechBubble, BubbleGroup } from "@/components/manga/speech-bubble"

<SpeechBubble variant="shout" tail="bottom" tailAlign="end">Get down!</SpeechBubble>
```

### Screentone (`screentone`)

Screentone as a component: dots, lines, cross-hatching or noise, with density, angle and cell size (SVG patterns with patternTransform), and a stepped (never smooth) fade toward any side. Use it as a background (put labels on a plate with on-tone) or as a layer over art. Coloured by --tone-ink.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/screentone`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `pattern`: `"dots" | "lines" | "cross" | "noise"` (default `"dots"`) — Tone pattern.
  - `density`: `number` (default `20`) — Ink coverage in percent (5–60).
  - `angle`: `number` (default `45`) — Screen angle in degrees.
  - `size`: `number` (default `6`) — Cell size in px.
  - `fade`: `"none" | "top" | "bottom" | "start" | "end"` (default `"none"`) — Stepped fade direction.
  - `as`: `"background" | "layer"` (default `"background"`) — Behind children or overlaid on the parent.

```tsx
import { Screentone } from "@/components/manga/screentone"

<Screentone density={35} fade="bottom" className="h-48">Night falls</Screentone>
```

### Speed Lines (`speed-lines`)

Emphasis lines drawn in SVG at the real size: focus (radial concentration lines with an empty centre and a movable origin) or motion (tapered parallel lines at any direction). Density control, optional stepped animation (off with reduced motion). Children sit on top with a paper knockout, ideal for SFX.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/speed-lines`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"focus" | "motion"` (default `"focus"`) — Radial or parallel.
  - `originX / originY`: `number` (default `50`) — Focus origin in %.
  - `hole`: `number` (default `0.35`) — Empty centre (fraction of half-size).
  - `direction`: `number` (default `0`) — Motion angle in degrees.
  - `density`: `number` (default `0.6`) — Amount of lines (0.1–1).
  - `animated`: `boolean | "slow"` (default `false`) — Redraws the lines in steps: true ≈ 6 fps, "slow" ≈ 2 fps. Off with reduced motion.

```tsx
import { SpeedLines } from "@/components/manga/speed-lines"

<SpeedLines className="h-56 grid place-items-center">
  <span aria-hidden className="font-sfx text-6xl">ドン!</span>
</SpeedLines>
```

### Panel (`panel`)

Manga page layout. PanelGrid is the page (a CSS grid with gutters; cols, rows, gap, reading="rtl" for right-to-left panel order). Panel is a case placed on it (colSpan, rowSpan) with a 3px outline drawn in SVG, so a side can be cut on a slant (cut={{ side: "start" | "end", size }} in px; give the neighbour the opposite cut and the gutter stays parallel); ink panels for night scenes. PanelCaption is the narration box, a 2px case in a corner. Compose with SpeedLines, Screentone, SpeechBubble and Sfx.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/panel`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `cols / rows / gap`: `number / number / string` — On PanelGrid: the page grid.
  - `reading`: `"ltr" | "rtl"` — On PanelGrid: panel order; defaults to the page setting (data-reading on <html>).
  - `colSpan / rowSpan`: `number` — On Panel: cells covered.
  - `cut`: `{ side: "start" | "end"; size?: number }` — On Panel: slanted side, size in px (default 32).
  - `ink`: `boolean` — On Panel: ink background, paper lines.
  - `position`: `"top-start" | "top-end" | "bottom-start" | "bottom-end"` (default `"top-start"`) — On PanelCaption: corner.

```tsx
import { Panel, PanelCaption, PanelGrid } from "@/components/manga/panel"

<PanelGrid cols={3} rows={2} className="aspect-[4/3]">
  <Panel colSpan={2} rowSpan={2}>…</Panel>
  <Panel cut={{ side: "start" }}>
    <PanelCaption>Midnight.</PanelCaption>
  </Panel>
  <Panel>…</Panel>
</PanelGrid>
```

### Sfx (`sfx`)

Onomatopoeia lettering: the SFX face (covers katakana) with a paper knockout, a tilt and a stepped pop when it appears. Variants solid (ink letters) and outline (paper letters, ink outline). Decorative by default (aria-hidden); pass label to make it spoken.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/sfx`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `size`: `"sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl"` (default `"md"`) — Letter size.
  - `rotate`: `number` (default `-8`) — Tilt in degrees.
  - `variant`: `"solid" | "outline"` (default `"solid"`) — Ink letters or outlined paper letters.
  - `animated`: `boolean` (default `true`) — Stepped pop on appear (off with reduced motion).
  - `label`: `string` — Spoken text; without it the SFX is aria-hidden.

```tsx
import { Sfx } from "@/components/manga/sfx"

<Sfx size="lg" rotate={-10}>ドン</Sfx>
<Sfx variant="outline" label="Silence">シーン</Sfx>
```

### Textarea (`textarea`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Textarea, drawn like Input: 2px ink line that thickens on hover, 3px with ink / paper / ink on focus, italic placeholder, dashed line and tone frame when disabled, accent line and a "!" mark on aria-invalid.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/textarea`
- Categories: actions

```tsx
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/manga/textarea"

<Textarea placeholder="Your review…" />
```

### Label (`label`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Label: lettering face, uppercase, never faded when its field is disabled. Optional required asterisk.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/label`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `required`: `boolean` — Adds an ink asterisk.

```tsx
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/manga/label"

<Label htmlFor="pen">Pen name</Label>
```

### Field (`field`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Field family (Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldSet, FieldLegend, FieldGroup, FieldSeparator). Labels in lettering, descriptions in ink, errors in the accent with a "!" mark and a shake. A choice card (FieldLabel wrapping a Field) is a 2px case; checked, it gets a 6px ink bar at the start.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/field`
- Categories: actions

```tsx
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/manga/field"

<Field>
  <FieldLabel htmlFor="email">Email</FieldLabel>
  <Input id="email" aria-invalid />
  <FieldError>Add the end of your address.</FieldError>
</Field>
```

### Radio Group (`radio-group`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Radio Group. Each option is a small diamond (only speech bubbles are round): the line thickens on hover, the checked one is an ink flat that sweeps in with a paper dot. Dashed when disabled.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/radio-group`
- Categories: actions

```tsx
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/manga/radio-group"

<RadioGroup defaultValue="ltr">
  <label><RadioGroupItem value="ltr" /> Left to right</label>
  <label><RadioGroupItem value="rtl" /> Right to left</label>
</RadioGroup>
```

### Slider (`slider`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Slider: a 2px ink rail whose filled part runs with speed lines, and an ink block thumb with a paper gap. Hover thickens the thumb line; dashed rail when disabled.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/slider`
- Categories: actions

```tsx
import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/manga/slider"

<Slider defaultValue={[40]} max={100} />
```

### Alert (`alert`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Alert: a 3px case with a tone shadow that pops in. destructive: accent line, a "!" column at the start and a shake when it appears. Title in lettering.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/alert`
- Categories: feedback
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"default" | "destructive"` (default `"default"`) — Destructive adds the accent and the “!” mark.

```tsx
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "@/components/ui/manga/alert"

<Alert variant="destructive">
  <AlertTitle>Upload failed</AlertTitle>
  <AlertDescription>Page 15 is too large.</AlertDescription>
</Alert>
```

### Alert Dialog (`alert-dialog`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Alert Dialog: a 3px case that pops in over three steps (flash adds a halo of concentration lines, off by default), over the light screentone veil from base. Action and Cancel are drawn as manga buttons; the action hits on click (tone="destructive" for irreversible actions).

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/alert-dialog`
- Categories: overlays
- Props:
  - `tone`: `"default" | "destructive"` (default `"default"`) — On AlertDialogAction: the button look.
  - `flash`: `boolean` (default `false`) — On AlertDialogContent: a halo of concentration lines around the window as it opens.

```tsx
import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/alert-dialog"

<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger>Delete volume</AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Delete Vol. 3?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>This cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Keep</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction tone="destructive">Delete</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
```

### Manpu (`manpu`)

Emotion marks drawn for the kit (manpu): anger vein, sweat drop, surprise lines, question mark, sparkle, gloom lines, love, sigh. Ink strokes that pop in; anger and sparkle keep a small stepped motion. Decorative by default; pass label to make it spoken.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/manpu`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `kind`: `"anger" | "sweat" | "surprise" | "question" | "sparkle" | "gloom" | "love" | "sigh"` — Which mark.
  - `size`: `string` (default `"1.5em"`) — Width and height.
  - `animated`: `boolean` (default `true`) — Pop in, plus a stepped motion for some marks.
  - `label`: `string` — Spoken meaning; without it the mark is aria-hidden.

```tsx
import { Manpu } from "@/components/manga/manpu"

<Manpu kind="sweat" />
<Manpu kind="anger" label="Angry" />
```

### Burst (`burst`)

A starburst drawn in SVG (irregular spikes, 3px outline) with its content centred on the flat, never on a tone. Variants ink, paper and accent; it fidgets in steps on hover, or always.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/burst`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"ink" | "paper" | "accent"` (default `"ink"`) — Fill.
  - `points`: `number` (default `14`) — Number of spikes.
  - `animated`: `boolean | "always"` (default `true`) — Fidgets on hover, or all the time.
  - `seed`: `number` — Changes the irregularity.

```tsx
import { Burst } from "@/components/manga/burst"

<Burst>NEW!</Burst>
<Burst variant="accent" animated="always">-50%</Burst>
```

### Stamp (`stamp`)

A seal in the accent colour: double square frame, heavy lettering, slightly uneven ink, tilted; lands with a thump. Horizontal or vertical (top to bottom). tone="ink" draws it in ink for everyday statuses.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/stamp`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `rotate`: `number` (default `-8`) — Tilt in degrees.
  - `orientation`: `"horizontal" | "vertical"` (default `"horizontal"`) — Text direction.
  - `animated`: `boolean` (default `true`) — Lands with a stepped thump.
  - `tone`: `"accent" | "ink"` (default `"accent"`) — accent for what must stand out, ink for everyday statuses.

```tsx
import { Stamp } from "@/components/manga/stamp"

<Stamp>Approved</Stamp>
<Stamp orientation="vertical">完了</Stamp>
```

A title ribbon for announcements and section heads: ink, paper or accent, with swallowtail or straight ends; optional speed lines running out from both ends (never under the text).

### Stepper (`stepper`)

Steps as chapter marks: done steps get a brush check, the current one is an ink flat that sweeps in, the next ones are paper squares; the rail between done steps runs with speed lines. Horizontal or vertical; follows the manga reading order.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/stepper`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `steps`: `{ label; description? }[]` — The steps.
  - `current`: `number` — Index of the current step.
  - `orientation`: `"horizontal" | "vertical"` (default `"horizontal"`) — Layout.

```tsx
import { Stepper } from "@/components/manga/stepper"

<Stepper current={1} steps={[{ label: "Account" }, { label: "Shelf" }, { label: "Done" }]} />
```

### Stat (`stat`)

A key figure in a case: label in lettering, the number in the SFX face, a brush arrow for the trend. With emphasis, concentration lines burst around the case (never under the number).

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/stat`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `label / value`: `ReactNode` — What and how much.
  - `delta`: `ReactNode` — Change, e.g. "+8%".
  - `trend`: `"up" | "down" | "flat"` (default `"flat"`) — Arrow direction.
  - `emphasis`: `boolean` (default `false`) — Focus lines around the case.

```tsx
import { Stat } from "@/components/manga/stat"

<Stat label="Readers" value="12.4k" delta="+8%" trend="up" emphasis />
```

### Typography (`typography`)

Plain styled elements for manga text, with no state and no gesture of their own. Headings use the lettering face (TypographyH1 and H2 switch to the SFX face with the sfx prop); body text uses the reading face. Variants: TypographyH1, H2 (ink rule underneath), H3, H4, P, Lead, Large, Small, Muted (smaller, same ink, never grey), Blockquote (a narration box: a 2px case with a 6px ink bar at the start), List, InlineCode (fine frame, monospace) and Table (an ink header and 1px row rules, the kit Table look). Each accepts className and the element's props.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/typography`
- Categories: foundations
- Props:
  - `sfx`: `boolean` — On TypographyH1 and TypographyH2: use the SFX face instead of the lettering face.
  - `TypographyTable`: `table props` — Native thead / tbody / tr / th / td children, in a case with the kit Table look.

```tsx
import { TypographyH1, TypographyP, TypographyBlockquote } from "@/components/ui/manga/typography"

<TypographyH1>The long night</TypographyH1>
<TypographyP>The harbour lamps came on one by one.</TypographyP>
<TypographyBlockquote>The ferry left at dawn.</TypographyBlockquote>
```

### Command (`command`)

Manga-styled command palette (cmdk). The palette is a case (3px ink line, tone shadow) with a search row drawn like an input with a search mark and a 2px line under it. Group headings are underlined lettering; the highlighted item inverts to an ink flat; the chosen item gets a brush check; disabled items keep the label with a dashed underline. Shortcuts are mono lettering in a fine frame. CommandDialog pops in over three steps, and its case is the palette itself. Empty state uses a “…” mark. Gestures: G1 case, G2 flat, G3 hover inversion, G5 pop, G8 check.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/command`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `CommandDialog`: `component` — The palette in a dialog (open, onOpenChange, title, description). The dialog frame is hidden: the palette draws the case.
  - `CommandInput`: `component` — The search row: a search mark, an input in the reading face, a 2px line under it.
  - `CommandEmpty`: `component` — Shown when nothing matches: a “…” mark and a short line (children override the text).
  - `CommandItem`: `component` — An option. disabled keeps the label with a dashed underline; data-checked="true" shows the brush check.
  - `CommandShortcut`: `component` — A shortcut in mono lettering inside a fine frame, at the end of an item.

```tsx
import { Command, CommandDialog, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList, CommandShortcut } from "@/components/ui/manga/command"

<Command>
  <CommandInput placeholder="Search chapters…" />
  <CommandList>
    <CommandEmpty>No page matches.</CommandEmpty>
    <CommandGroup heading="Read">
      <CommandItem value="chapter-12">
        Chapter 12 — The rooftop
        <CommandShortcut>1</CommandShortcut>
      </CommandItem>
    </CommandGroup>
  </CommandList>
</Command>
```

### Toggle (`toggle`)

Manga-styled on/off button (Base UI or Radix toggle). Variants: default (frameless: inverts to ink on hover) and outline (2px frame on paper: lifts its tone shadow on hover). Sizes sm, default, lg. Off is paper; on (aria-pressed or data-state=on) is an ink flat that sweeps in over three frames. Click plays the impact (speed lines, 2px recoil). Disabled: dashed line, tone frame, label on paper, not-allowed cursor. Gestures: G2 flat, G3 hover, G4 impact.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/toggle`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"default" | "outline"` — default: frameless, inverts on hover · outline: 2px frame, lifts on hover.
  - `size`: `"sm" | "default" | "lg"` — Height 32, 40 or 48 px.
  - `pressed / defaultPressed`: `boolean` — Stock toggle state: on shows the ink flat.
  - `disabled`: `boolean` — Dashed line, tone frame, label on paper.

```tsx
import { Toggle } from "@/components/ui/manga/toggle"

<Toggle aria-label="Bold" defaultPressed>Bold</Toggle>
<Toggle variant="outline" size="sm">Captions</Toggle>
```

### Toggle Group (`toggle-group`)

Manga-styled group of toggles (Base UI or Radix). By default (spacing 0) the toggles share one frame, split by a 2px line like the cells of a boxed Tabs; the pressed cell is an ink flat that sweeps in; hover thickens the line of a cell. With spacing above 0 each toggle is a framed button of its own. Orientation horizontal or vertical. Single and multiple selection come from the stock API (value / defaultValue arrays, multiple). Focus stays inside its cell. Gestures: G2 flat, G3 hover on cells, G4 impact.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/toggle-group`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `spacing`: `number` — 0 (default): one joined frame. Above 0: separate framed toggles with that gap.
  - `orientation`: `"horizontal" | "vertical"` — Row or column. The joined lines follow the orientation.
  - `multiple`: `boolean` — Stock Base UI option: several cells may be pressed at once.
  - `variant / size`: `"default" | "outline" / "sm" | "default" | "lg"` — Passed to every item.

```tsx
import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/manga/toggle-group"

<ToggleGroup aria-label="Alignment" defaultValue={["center"]}>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="left">Left</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="center">Centre</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="right">Right</ToggleGroupItem>
</ToggleGroup>
```

### Button Group (`button-group`)

Manga-styled group of buttons and inputs joined in one row or column. Shared edges collapse to one 2px line; the outer corners follow the radius. A ButtonGroupSeparator is an ink rule (2px, no tone) between two buttons. ButtonGroupText is a label cell in the same frame. Works with the kit Button and Input. Vertical orientation is supported. The focused button draws its ring inside itself, never over a neighbour. Gestures: the buttons keep their own G3 hover, G4 impact and focus.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/button-group`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `orientation`: `"horizontal" | "vertical"` — Row (default) or column; the shared line follows it.
  - `ButtonGroupSeparator`: `component` — An ink rule between two items. orientation vertical (default) in a row, horizontal in a column.
  - `ButtonGroupText`: `component` — A label cell in the frame (paper, lettering).

```tsx
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/manga/button"
import { ButtonGroup, ButtonGroupSeparator } from "@/components/ui/manga/button-group"

<ButtonGroup aria-label="Pages">
  <Button variant="outline">Prev</Button>
  <ButtonGroupSeparator />
  <Button variant="outline">Next</Button>
</ButtonGroup>
```

### Scroll Area (`scroll-area`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Scroll Area. The scrollbar thumb is a flat of ink inset in a fine ink track (a 1px line on the start edge). No rounded pill, no opacity fade, a square corner. The viewport focus ring is an ink line inside the area. Keyboard and wheel behaviour are stock. Add a horizontal bar with ScrollBar orientation="horizontal". Works with Radix and Base UI.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/scroll-area`
- Categories: display

```tsx
import { ScrollArea, ScrollBar } from "@/components/ui/manga/scroll-area"

<ScrollArea className="h-56">
  <p>Long text goes here.</p>
</ScrollArea>

<ScrollArea className="w-56">
  <div className="w-[28rem]">Wide content</div>
  <ScrollBar orientation="horizontal" />
</ScrollArea>
```

### Collapsible (`collapsible`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Collapsible. The trigger is a frameless lettering row: its underline thickens on hover and its brush chevron turns in two steps when open. The content unfolds with a drop-in by steps. No frame of its own, so it sits on the page or inside a case the caller adds. Disabled keeps the label on paper with a dashed underline and a not-allowed cursor. Works with Radix and Base UI.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/collapsible`

### Navigation Menu (`navigation-menu`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Navigation Menu. Top-level triggers are frameless lettering: an underline thickens on hover, and the open one is an ink flat that sweeps in, with a brush chevron that turns in two steps. The panel is an ink case that pops in, its links invert on hover and the current link is an ink flat. Focus is an ink line inside the shape. Works with Radix and Base UI: the viewport ring and shadow are removed on Radix, the stock Base UI popup keeps its own ring. Items that open a panel use NavigationMenuItem with a value; a plain NavigationMenuLink needs no panel.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/navigation-menu`
- Categories: navigation

```tsx
import { NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuContent, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuLink, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/navigation-menu"

<NavigationMenu>
  <NavigationMenuList>
    <NavigationMenuItem value="chapters">
      <NavigationMenuTrigger>Chapters</NavigationMenuTrigger>
      <NavigationMenuContent>
        <NavigationMenuLink href="/chapter-1">The long night</NavigationMenuLink>
      </NavigationMenuContent>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
  </NavigationMenuList>
</NavigationMenu>
```

### Sidebar (`sidebar`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Sidebar. Desktop: a case with a 3px ink edge on its open side (like Sheet), paper inside. Rows are frameless and invert to ink on hover; the current row is an ink flat that sweeps in over three frames, as in Tabs. Group labels are underlined lettering. Badges are paper plates with an ink frame. The trigger is an ink square that inverts on hover; the rail is an ink line that thickens on hover. Collapsed (icon) mode keeps square icon cells. Mobile: the same panel as a sheet that slides in from its edge, with an offset second frame. Clicks hit with the impact gesture. Disabled rows: dashed frame and tone frame, label on paper. Parts: SidebarProvider, Sidebar, SidebarTrigger, SidebarRail, SidebarInset, SidebarHeader, SidebarFooter, SidebarContent, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarMenuButton (isActive, tooltip), SidebarMenuAction, SidebarMenuBadge, SidebarMenuSub, SidebarMenuSubButton, SidebarInput, SidebarSeparator, useSidebar.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/sidebar`
- Categories: navigation
- Props:
  - `collapsible`: `"offcanvas" | "icon" | "none"` — On Sidebar. icon keeps square icon cells when collapsed; offcanvas slides the panel away; none is always open.
  - `side`: `"left" | "right"` — On Sidebar. Puts the 3px ink edge on the open side.
  - `isActive`: `boolean` — On SidebarMenuButton and SidebarMenuSubButton: the current row, an ink flat.
  - `tooltip`: `string | TooltipContent props` — On SidebarMenuButton: shown beside the icon when the panel is collapsed to icons.
  - `showOnHover`: `boolean` — On SidebarMenuAction: show the star only when the row is hovered.

```tsx
import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarProvider, SidebarInset, SidebarTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/sidebar"

<SidebarProvider>
  <Sidebar collapsible="icon">
    <SidebarContent>
      <SidebarGroup>
        <SidebarGroupLabel>Browse</SidebarGroupLabel>
        <SidebarMenu>
          <SidebarMenuItem>
            <SidebarMenuButton isActive>Library</SidebarMenuButton>
          </SidebarMenuItem>
        </SidebarMenu>
      </SidebarGroup>
    </SidebarContent>
  </Sidebar>
  <SidebarInset>
    <SidebarTrigger />
  </SidebarInset>
</SidebarProvider>
```

### Item (`item`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Item: a list row with a media square, a title, a description and actions at the end. Variants: default (frameless row), outline (a 2px ink case), muted (a 1px fine ink line on paper with a 6px tone band on the start edge, outside the text; no inner tone frame, so it never reads as disabled). Sizes default, sm, xs. Media is a 40px square case with a 2px ink frame. Titles are lettering; descriptions take the row's colour. Pass interactive for a row that is clicked: a frameless row inverts to ink on hover (G3), a framed or muted row thickens its line by 1px. Disabled: dashed frame with a tone frame and the label on paper. Also ItemGroup (a list), ItemSeparator (a fine ink line), ItemHeader and ItemFooter.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/item`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"default" | "outline" | "muted"` (default `"default"`) — default: frameless row. outline: 2px ink case. muted: 1px fine line with a 6px tone band on the start edge.
  - `size`: `"default" | "sm" | "xs"` (default `"default"`) — Padding and gap of the row.
  - `interactive`: `boolean` (default `false`) — G3 hover: a frameless row inverts to ink, a framed or muted row thickens its line.

```tsx
import { Item, ItemMedia, ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ItemActions } from "@/components/ui/manga/item"

<Item variant="outline" interactive>
  <ItemMedia>
    <BookOpen />
  </ItemMedia>
  <ItemContent>
    <ItemTitle>Vol. 1 · The long night</ItemTitle>
    <ItemDescription>Twelve chapters, two unread.</ItemDescription>
  </ItemContent>
  <ItemActions>
    <ChevronRight />
  </ItemActions>
</Item>
```

### Kbd (`kbd`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Kbd: a key cap drawn in ink. A 2px frame with a heavier 3px bottom edge, like a pressed key; paper inside; lettering inside, uppercase. KbdGroup spaces a chord (Ctrl K). No tone (under 24px). Keys are not interactive: no hover, press or focus state. Works inline in a sentence, in a tooltip and on an ink flat.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/kbd`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `KbdGroup`: `component` — Spaces a chord of keys (Ctrl, Shift, K) on one line.

```tsx
import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from "@/components/ui/manga/kbd"

<p>
  Search with <KbdGroup><Kbd>Ctrl</Kbd><Kbd>K</Kbd></KbdGroup>
</p>
```

### Chart (`chart`)

Manga-styled wrapper around the shadcn Chart (recharts). Series are told apart by screentone and hatching, never by colour: chartFill(series) gives each series a pattern (solid ink, 45° hatching, dots, horizontal lines, cross hatching, fine dots), bars and areas are outlined in 2px ink, pie slices are separated by paper gaps. Lines differ by dash and by marker (ChartMarker: square, diamond, dot). The container is a case; the tooltip is a speech bubble with a tail; the legend shows pattern swatches. Exports ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent, ChartLegend, ChartLegendContent, ChartStyle, ChartPatterns, ChartMarker, chartFill, chartPattern, chartPatternFill and type ChartConfig. Ink and paper only, dark mode is the negative.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/chart`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `ChartContainer`: `{ config, id?, className? } + recharts children` — A case around the recharts container. className goes on the case; --chart-h sets the height.
  - `chartFill(series, keys?)`: `(number | string, string[]?) => string` — The url(#…) fill of a series: by index, or by its config key in keys. The first series is solid ink.
  - `chartPattern / chartPatternFill`: `helpers` — The pattern name of a series, or the fill of a named pattern (solid, paper, hatch, cross, dots, dots-fine, lines).
  - `ChartMarker`: `{ cx, cy, kind?: "square" | "diamond" | "dot", size? }` — Point marker for a line's dot prop: a paper shape with an ink outline.
  - `ChartTooltipContent`: `recharts tooltip props` — Speech bubble with a tail; the indicator is hidden by default (set hideIndicator={false} to show it).
  - `ChartLegendContent`: `{ config?, payload?, verticalAlign? }` — Legend with a pattern swatch per series; labels come from the config.

```tsx
import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis } from "recharts"
import { ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent, ChartLegend, ChartLegendContent, chartFill, type ChartConfig } from "@/components/ui/manga/chart"

const config = { reads: { label: "Reads" }, sales: { label: "Sales" } } satisfies ChartConfig
const keys = Object.keys(config)

<ChartContainer config={config}>
  <BarChart data={data}>
    <XAxis dataKey="month" />
    <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
    <ChartLegend content={<ChartLegendContent config={config} />} />
    <Bar dataKey="reads" fill={chartFill("reads", keys)} stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} />
    <Bar dataKey="sales" fill={chartFill("sales", keys)} stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} />
  </BarChart>
</ChartContainer>
```

### Data Table (`data-table`)

A sortable, filterable, selectable table built on @tanstack/react-table and the mangacn Table. The table is a case with an ink header; sorted columns show a brush arrow (aria-sort); the hovered row gets its ink bar and selected rows a 6px bar. The toolbar has a filter field (filterColumn) and a column visibility menu (grouped, checkable items). Row selection uses the mangacn Checkbox, with a select-all in the header; pagination uses the mangacn Button. An empty filter result shows the "…" mark (TableEmpty). Props: columns, data, filterColumn?, pageSize?, onSelectionChange?(rows). Also exports selectColumn. On phones (table narrower than 640px) rows become cards: checkbox, title, badge, labelled lines; set `meta: { card: ... }` on a column to choose.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/data-table`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `columns`: `ColumnDef<TData, TValue>[]` — Column definitions. A selection column is added first by the table.
  - `data`: `TData[]` — The rows.
  - `filterColumn`: `string` — Column id searched by the toolbar filter.
  - `pageSize`: `number` — Rows per page (default 10).
  - `onSelectionChange`: `(rows: TData[]) => void` — Called with the selected rows, in data order, when the selection changes.
  - `selectColumn`: `() => ColumnDef<TData>` — The leading checkbox column, for custom placement.
  - `cardsBelow`: `number` (default `640`) — Width of the table, in px, under which each row becomes a card (0 keeps the table). Columns pick their place with meta.card: "title", "badge", "line" or false.

```tsx
import { DataTable } from "@/components/ui/manga/data-table"
import type { ColumnDef } from "@tanstack/react-table"

const columns: ColumnDef<Chapter>[] = [
  { accessorKey: "title", header: "Chapter" },
  { accessorKey: "pages", header: "Pages" },
]

<DataTable columns={columns} data={chapters} filterColumn="title" pageSize={10} onSelectionChange={(rows) => setPicked(rows)} />
```

### Toned Image (`toned-image`)

Any picture turned into a manga screentone: black and white, dark areas become dense dots or lines in ink, light areas stay paper. Patterns: dots (45° screen), lines, cross, noise. Settings: density (cell size in px), contrast, threshold (solid ink above a darkness level). Done with CSS only (blend modes, filters, radial and linear gradients, a feTurbulence noise tile as background): same look in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, cross-origin pictures work, nothing uploaded. Ink is the foreground colour, paper the background; dark mode is the negative. Keeps alt text.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/toned-image`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `src / alt`: `string` — The picture and its text alternative (kept). Same-origin, data: or blob: URL.
  - `pattern`: `"dots" | "lines" | "cross" | "noise"` (default `"dots"`) — The screen.
  - `density`: `number` (default `6`) — Cell size in px: smaller is a finer screen. Blur and screen scale with it.
  - `contrast`: `number` (default `1`) — Above 1 pushes shadows and lights apart.
  - `threshold`: `number (0 to 1)` (default `0`) — 0 is off. Above 0, more of the picture goes solid ink (dark areas first).
  - `className`: `string` — Sets the size and the frame, e.g. aspect-[4/3] w-full border-ink.

```tsx
import { TonedImage } from "@/components/manga/toned-image"

<TonedImage src="/city.jpg" alt="A city at dusk" pattern="dots" density={6} className="aspect-[4/3] w-full border-ink" />
```

### Character Card (`character-card`)

A character sheet in a case: a portrait panel (toned as a screentone, or the initials on paper), the name in lettering, the role, stats as bars filled with speed lines, tags (kit Badge) and a short quote in a small speech bubble. Static by default; interactive adds the hover lift and the ink focus ring.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/character-card`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `name`: `string` — Set in lettering.
  - `role`: `string` — Title or occupation, under the name.
  - `image`: `string` — Portrait URL, toned. Without it, the initials stand on paper.
  - `stats`: `{ label: string; value: number; max?: number }[]` (default `[]`) — Bars filled with speed lines. max defaults to 100.
  - `tags`: `string[]` (default `[]`) — Small outline badges.
  - `quote`: `string` — A line in a small speech bubble.
  - `interactive`: `boolean` (default `false`) — Hover lift and focus ring; the card takes focus.

```tsx
import { CharacterCard } from "@/components/manga/character-card"

<CharacterCard
  name="Kai Mori"
  role="Courier"
  image="/kai.jpg"
  stats={[{ label: "Power", value: 82 }, { label: "Speed", value: 6, max: 10 }]}
  tags={["Rooftops"]}
  quote="The bridge is closed."
  interactive
/>
```

### Impact Counter (`impact-counter`)

A number that changes with an impact: when the value changes, the number takes the three-frame hit (G4) with speed lines on both sides, and a growing value flashes a "+n" burst (G8) that leaves after a moment. Lettering after the number, optional icon, custom format. Sizes sm, default, lg. Reduced motion: the new number only. Built for likes, streaks and scores.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/impact-counter`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `value`: `number` — The number. Each change plays the impact.
  - `label`: `ReactNode` — Lettering after the number.
  - `size`: `"sm" | "default" | "lg"` (default `"default"`) — Size of the number.
  - `format`: `(value: number) => string` — How the number is written. Default: en-US thousands.
  - `icon`: `ReactNode` — A small mark before the number.

```tsx
import { ImpactCounter } from "@/components/manga/impact-counter"

<ImpactCounter value={likes} label="likes" />
```

### Input Group (`input-group`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Input Group. The whole group is drawn like Input: a 2px ink line on paper; the inner input or textarea has no line of its own. Hover thickens the group's line (G3, fields); focus on the control thickens it to 3px with a paper gap and an ink ring around the group; aria-invalid on the control gives an accent line, a "!" mark and a serrated bottom edge; a disabled control gives a dashed line and a tone frame with the text on paper. Addons and InputGroupText read in ink in the reading face. InputGroupButton is a small kit button (2px frame, lettering, hover inverts to ink, pressed is a negative with a 2px offset, focus ring kept inside the group). Block addons (block-start / block-end) are separated by a fine ink rule. At least 44px tall under 640px. Exports inputGroupClassName for components whose input is an input group (Combobox).

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/input-group`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `align`: `"inline-start" | "inline-end" | "block-start" | "block-end"` — On InputGroupAddon: where the addon sits. Block addons get a fine ink rule.
  - `size`: `"xs" | "sm" | "icon-xs" | "icon-sm"` — On InputGroupButton: the button size (a 44px touch target under 640px).
  - `aria-invalid`: `boolean` — On InputGroupInput / InputGroupTextarea: the error look on the whole group.
  - `inputGroupClassName`: `string` — The group look, for a stock input group you do not render yourself.

```tsx
import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupButton, InputGroupInput, InputGroupText } from "@/components/ui/manga/input-group"

<InputGroup>
  <InputGroupAddon>
    <InputGroupText>https://</InputGroupText>
  </InputGroupAddon>
  <InputGroupInput placeholder="your-circle.example" />
  <InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">
    <InputGroupButton>Check</InputGroupButton>
  </InputGroupAddon>
</InputGroup>
```

### Native Select (`native-select`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Native Select (a real <select>). Drawn like the kit Select trigger: a 2px ink line on paper and a brush chevron (mark-chevron) in place of the stock icon. Hover thickens the line (G3, fields); focus thickens it to 3px with a paper gap and an ink ring; aria-invalid gives an accent line, a "!" mark before the chevron and a serrated bottom edge; disabled gives a dashed line and a tone frame with the label on paper and a not-allowed cursor. Sizes default and sm, both 44px tall under 640px. The options keep the browser's native popup.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/native-select`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `size`: `"sm" | "default"` — Height and text size (44px tall under 640px either way).
  - `aria-invalid`: `boolean` — The error look: accent line, "!" mark, serrated bottom edge.
  - `NativeSelectOptGroup`: `component` — A labelled group of options (native optgroup).

```tsx
import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption } from "@/components/ui/manga/native-select"

<NativeSelect defaultValue="rtl">
  <NativeSelectOption value="rtl">Right to left</NativeSelectOption>
  <NativeSelectOption value="ltr">Left to right</NativeSelectOption>
</NativeSelect>
```

### Context Menu (`context-menu`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Context Menu: a case that opens at the pointer (no notch), popping in. Rows invert to ink on hover or keyboard focus; checkbox rows get a brush check, radio rows an ink diamond; destructive rows use the accent; sub-menus have a brush chevron. Rows are 44px tall under 640 px. Put ContextMenuLabel inside a ContextMenuGroup: Base UI requires it (Radix does not). Works with Base UI and Radix.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/context-menu`
- Categories: overlays

```tsx
import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/context-menu"

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger>Right-click this page</ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent>
    <ContextMenuItem>Bookmark</ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuItem variant="destructive">Delete</ContextMenuItem>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

### Menubar (`menubar`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Menubar: a 2px frame with lettering triggers in a group. A trigger thickens its line on hover, an open trigger is an ink flat, and focus is drawn inside the cell. Menus are the Dropdown Menu panel with the notch toward the trigger. On phones the bar wraps so every trigger keeps a 44px target. Works with Base UI and Radix.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/menubar`

```tsx
    </MenubarContent>
  </MenubarMenu>
</Menubar>
```

### Resizable (`resizable`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Resizable panels (react-resizable-panels v4). The handle is a 2px ink line: hover thickens it by 1px per side, focus draws the focus ring, and a grip (withHandle) is a small 2px-framed box that turns to an ink flat while dragging. The hit area is 24px wide (44px under 640 px). Put the group inside a case (ink-case) to frame the panels.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/resizable`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `withHandle`: `boolean` (default `false`) — On ResizableHandle: draws the grip (a small 2px-framed box with two ink lines).

```tsx
import { ResizableHandle, ResizablePanel, ResizablePanelGroup } from "@/components/ui/manga/resizable"

<ResizablePanelGroup orientation="horizontal" className="ink-case relative h-80">
  <ResizablePanel defaultSize="60">Page</ResizablePanel>
  <ResizableHandle withHandle />
  <ResizablePanel defaultSize="40">Notes</ResizablePanel>
</ResizablePanelGroup>
```

### Aspect Ratio (`aspect-ratio`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Aspect Ratio. No manga effect: it is a layout tool, so only the data-manga hook is added. Same API: pass a ratio (width / height) and the child fills the box.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/aspect-ratio`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `ratio`: `number` (default `-`) — Width divided by height (16 / 9, 2 / 3, 1).

```tsx
import { AspectRatio } from "@/components/ui/manga/aspect-ratio"

<AspectRatio ratio={16 / 9}>
  <img src="/cover.jpg" alt="Cover" className="size-full object-cover" />
</AspectRatio>
```

### Drawer (`drawer`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Drawer (Base UI drawer or vaul). Like Sheet docked to an edge: paper, a 3px ink line on the open side and an offset second frame thrown onto the page as its shadow, in all four directions. The grab handle is a 2px ink bar with square ends, 64px wide; the title is in lettering; the footer sits above a 2px rule. The library keeps its own slide and drag transforms; the wrapper only makes their timing stepped (steps(5)), so swiping still follows the finger, and nothing moves with reduced motion. The veil comes from base. Adds DrawerCard, a static look-alike of an open drawer for previews and frozen states. Buttons inside are the kit Button.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/drawer`
- Categories: overlays
- Props:
  - `swipeDirection / direction`: `"down" | "up" | "left" | "right" (Base UI) · "bottom" | "top" | "left" | "right" (vaul)` — On Drawer: the edge it slides from, with each library's own prop. The 3px line and the offset frame follow it.
  - `DrawerCard`: `component` — Static twin of an open drawer: side, handle, title, description, footer, children. No portal, no veil.

```tsx
import { Drawer, DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerFooter, DrawerHeader, DrawerTitle, DrawerTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/drawer"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/manga/button"

<Drawer>
  <DrawerTrigger>Reading goal</DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerContent>
    <DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerTitle>Daily reading goal</DrawerTitle>
      <DrawerDescription>How many chapters a day?</DrawerDescription>
    </DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerFooter><Button>Set the goal</Button></DrawerFooter>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>
```

### Carousel (`carousel`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Carousel (embla). Every slide is a panel: its content gets a 2px ink frame on paper (ink-case-inner). Previous / Next are the kit outline icon button with a brush arrow: the tone shadow appears on hover, pressed is a negative with impact lines, focus is the ink / paper / ink ring, disabled is dashed with a tone frame. Under 640px they grow to 44px and sit inside the carousel width, in a row under the slides (stock places them 48px outside). Adds CarouselDots, a mangacn addition built on useCarousel: square dots, the current one an ink flat that sweeps in, 24px hit areas (44px under 640px). Manga reading order: under data-reading="rtl" (or opts.direction "rtl", or dir="rtl") embla runs right to left, slides flow right to left, the arrows and arrow keys follow; text stays left to right. Vertical orientation puts the buttons above and below and uses the up / down keys.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/carousel`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `CarouselDots`: `component` — mangacn addition: one square dot per snap point; the current one is an ink flat. Uses useCarousel.
  - `opts.direction`: `"ltr" | "rtl"` — On Carousel: the flow. Defaults to the page (data-reading="rtl" or dir="rtl" give "rtl").
  - `orientation`: `"horizontal" | "vertical"` — On Carousel. Vertical puts the buttons above and below and uses the up / down keys.

```tsx
import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselDots, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious } from "@/components/ui/manga/carousel"

<Carousel className="sm:mx-12">
  <CarouselContent>
    <CarouselItem><div>Chapter 12</div></CarouselItem>
    <CarouselItem><div>Chapter 13</div></CarouselItem>
  </CarouselContent>
  <CarouselPrevious />
  <CarouselNext />
  <CarouselDots />
</Carousel>
```

### Versus Panel (`versus-panel`)

Two halves of a comparison split by a 3px ink diagonal, with a VS burst at the crossing. Side by side from a container width of 36rem, the halves stack below it and the split becomes a zig from left to right with the VS on it (container queries, no viewport breakpoints). Exactly two VersusSide children; highlight gives one side the ink flat with paper text (the recommended offer). Each side is a named region. Gestures: case (outer frame), flat (highlight), burst (VS mark).

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/versus-panel`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `label`: `string` (default `"VS"`) — Lettering on the crossing mark (decorative, aria-hidden).
  - `children`: `two <VersusSide> elements` — The two halves, in order: first left (or top when stacked).
  - `highlight`: `boolean` (default `false`) — On VersusSide: the recommended side, an ink flat with paper text.

```tsx
import { VersusPanel, VersusSide } from "@/components/manga/versus-panel"

<VersusPanel>
  <VersusSide aria-labelledby="free">
    <h3 id="free">Free</h3>
  </VersusSide>
  <VersusSide highlight aria-labelledby="pro">
    <h3 id="pro">Pro</h3>
  </VersusSide>
</VersusPanel>
```

### Loading Screen (`loading-screen`)

A waiting screen: concentration lines turning behind a paper plate, an onomatopoeia in the SFX face in the centre, an optional message and either a determinate bar filled with speed lines (progress 0 to 100) or an indeterminate turning spinner (progress omitted). role=status with aria-live=polite; the SFX is decorative. Fills its container by default; fullscreen covers the viewport (fixed, z-50). Lines stop under prefers-reduced-motion, the states stay distinct.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/loading-screen`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `sfx`: `string` (default `"ドドド"`) — Onomatopoeia in the centre (decorative).
  - `label`: `string` (default `"Loading"`) — Screen-reader text announced as the status.
  - `message`: `ReactNode` — Visible line under the SFX.
  - `progress`: `number` — 0 to 100 for a determinate bar. Omitted = indeterminate spinner.
  - `fullscreen`: `boolean` (default `false`) — Fixed, covers the viewport above the page. Otherwise fills its container.
  - `className`: `string` — Added to the root.

```tsx
import { LoadingScreen } from "@/components/manga/loading-screen"

<LoadingScreen message="Loading chapter 12" progress={40} />

<LoadingScreen fullscreen message="Hold on" />
```

### Volume Card (`volume-card`)

A manga volume in a case: a 2:3 cover framed in ink with the volume number as a lettering tag on its corner, the title in lettering, the author, a status (new as a burst, ongoing as an ink flat, completed with a brush check, hiatus as an outline) and reading progress as a bar filled with speed lines with the count. Static by default; with href it is a link, with onSelect a button, both with the hover lift, the ink focus ring and a pressed offset. Works in a two-column grid at 360 px.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/volume-card`
- Categories: manga
- Props:
  - `title`: `ReactNode` — Set in lettering.
  - `volume`: `number | string` — Shown as "Vol. 12" on the cover corner.
  - `cover`: `string | ReactNode` — An image URL, or any node drawn as the cover. Without it, a screentone.
  - `author`: `ReactNode` — Author or subtitle, under the title.
  - `status`: `"new" | "ongoing" | "completed" | "hiatus"` — Status mark: burst, ink flat, brush check or outline.
  - `read`: `number` (default `0`) — Chapters read. Shown with total.
  - `total`: `number` — Chapters in the volume. Shows the progress bar when set.
  - `href`: `string` — Makes the card a link.
  - `onSelect`: `() => void` — Makes the card a button.
  - `className`: `string` — Added to the card.

```tsx
import { VolumeCard } from "@/components/manga/volume-card"

<VolumeCard
  title="Night Rail"
  volume={2}
  cover="/covers/night-rail-2.jpg"
  author="M. Oda"
  status="ongoing"
  read={18}
  total={40}
  href="/volumes/2"
/>
```

### Combobox (`combobox`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Combobox (Base UI in both shadcn versions). The input is the kit input group: a 2px ink line on paper that thickens on hover (G3, fields) and gets 3px + paper + ink on focus; aria-invalid gives an accent line, a "!" mark and a serrated edge; disabled gives a dashed line and a tone frame. The chevron is a brush mark (mark-chevron) that turns when open; the clear button is a small 2px square that inverts on hover. The popup is a case (3px ink line, tone shadow) with a notch toward the input, popping in over three frames. The highlighted item inverts to ink; the chosen item gets a brush check that draws itself; disabled items keep the label with a dashed underline. Group labels are underlined lettering; the separator is a fine ink rule; the empty state is a solid-line box with a "…" mark and lettering. Chips (multiple) are drawn like Badge (2px frame, lettering, square) with a remove cell that inverts; focus stays inside the chip; chips wrap. Rows are 44px tall under 640px. Exports the class strings of the popup, item, label, empty state and chip for static look-alikes.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/combobox`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `showClear`: `boolean` — On ComboboxInput: a small 2px square clear button.
  - `aria-invalid`: `boolean` — On ComboboxInput or ComboboxChipsInput: the error look on the field.
  - `sideOffset`: `number` — On ComboboxContent: gap to the input (14 by default: room for the notch and the focus ring).
  - `ComboboxChips / ComboboxChip`: `component` — Multiple selection: Badge-like chips that wrap, with a remove cell.

```tsx
import { Combobox, ComboboxContent, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem, ComboboxList } from "@/components/ui/manga/combobox"

<Combobox items={series}>
  <ComboboxInput placeholder="Find a series…" />
  <ComboboxContent>
    <ComboboxEmpty>No series found</ComboboxEmpty>
    <ComboboxList>
      {(item) => <ComboboxItem key={item} value={item}>{item}</ComboboxItem>}
    </ComboboxList>
  </ComboboxContent>
</Combobox>
```

### Input OTP (`input-otp`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Input OTP (input-otp). The slots are joined 44px cells in one 2px ink frame (shared lines collapse to one 2px rule), each character large in the lettering face. Hover thickens the frame; the active slot gets a 3px line inside (never over its neighbours) and a 2px ink caret blinking in steps; focus adds ink / paper / ink around the group. The separator is a short 2px dash. aria-invalid (on InputOTP or on a slot) turns the lines to the accent and adds a "!" mark beside the group; disabled is dashed with a tone frame in each cell, characters kept on paper. Six slots and a separator fit a 360px screen.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/input-otp`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `maxLength`: `number` — Number of characters (one InputOTPSlot each).
  - `pattern`: `string` — Allowed characters, e.g. REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS from input-otp.
  - `aria-invalid`: `boolean` — On InputOTP (or a slot): accent lines and a "!" mark beside the group.
  - `disabled`: `boolean` — Dashed lines and a tone frame in each cell.
  - `InputOTPSeparator`: `component` — A short 2px ink dash between groups.

```tsx
import { InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSeparator, InputOTPSlot } from "@/components/ui/manga/input-otp"

<InputOTP maxLength={6}>
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
  <InputOTPSeparator />
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
</InputOTP>
```

### Calendar (`calendar`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Calendar (react-day-picker). No frame of its own: put it in a Card, a Popover or an ink-case. Month caption and weekday heads in the uppercase lettering face; square 2px-framed nav buttons with a brush chevron (hover thickens the line, focus is ink / paper / ink). Day cells are cells of a group: hover draws a 1px line inside, focus stays inside the cell. Selected day, range start and range end are ink flats that sweep in over three frames; today is a 2px ink frame (selected wins); the middle of a range is paper with a fine ink line above and below, never a tone behind the number. Outside days keep the same ink in a lighter weight; disabled days get a dashed line-through and a not-allowed cursor. The dropdown caption draws its month and year selects with a 2px line and a brush chevron. Cells are 40px; under 640px they share the available width up to 44px, so a month fits a 360px screen; several months sit side by side from 640px and stack on phones. Same API as the stock Calendar (mode single, multiple, range).

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/calendar`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `mode`: `"single" | "multiple" | "range"` — How days are chosen (react-day-picker). Chosen days are ink flats; a range shows a band between its ends.
  - `captionLayout`: `"label" | "dropdown" | "dropdown-months" | "dropdown-years"` (default `"label"`) — Dropdowns draw month and year selects with a 2px line and a brush chevron (use with startMonth / endMonth).
  - `numberOfMonths`: `number` — Months side by side from 640px; they stack on phones.
  - `disabled`: `Matcher | Matcher[]` — Days that cannot be chosen: dashed line-through, not-allowed cursor.
  - `CalendarDayButton`: `component` — The styled day cell, for custom components={{ DayButton }}.

```tsx
import { Calendar } from "@/components/ui/manga/calendar"

const [date, setDate] = React.useState<Date | undefined>(new Date())

<div className="relative w-fit ink-case">
  <Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} />
</div>
```

### Date Picker (`date-picker`)

mangacn's own Date Picker (shadcn documents it as a recipe, not an item): DatePicker (one date) and DateRangePicker (from / to), built on the manga Popover and Calendar. The trigger is a field like the Select trigger: 2px ink line, a drawn calendar mark, the placeholder in the same ink (italic, never grey), the date formatted with date-fns. Hover thickens the line, focus is ink / paper / ink, the line goes to 3px while open, disabled is dashed with a tone frame, aria-invalid adds the accent line and a "!" mark. The calendar opens in a speech bubble with a tail toward the trigger and pops in; choosing a day closes it (single). The range picker shows two months from 640px and one on phones, so the bubble fits a 360px screen. Works with Radix and Base UI (the trigger only gets a className).

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/date-picker`
- Categories: actions
- Props:
  - `value / defaultValue`: `Date (DatePicker) · DateRange (DateRangePicker)` — Controlled or initial value.
  - `onValueChange`: `(value) => void` — Called with the new date or range (undefined when cleared).
  - `placeholder`: `string` (default `"Pick a date" · "Pick dates"`) — Shown in the same ink, italic, while nothing is chosen.
  - `disabled`: `boolean` — Dashed line and tone frame; the calendar cannot open.
  - `formatString`: `string` (default `"LLL d, y"`) — date-fns format of each date in the trigger.
  - `calendarProps`: `Partial<PropsBase>` — Extra Calendar props: captionLayout, startMonth, endMonth, disabled days, locale…
  - `aria-invalid`: `boolean` — The error look: accent line and a "!" mark.
  - `datePickerTriggerClassName`: `(className?) => string` — The trigger look, for a static twin or a trigger of your own.

```tsx
import { DatePicker, DateRangePicker } from "@/components/ui/manga/date-picker"

<DatePicker placeholder="Release day" onValueChange={(date) => console.log(date)} />
<DateRangePicker placeholder="Trip dates" />
```

### Attachment (`attachment`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Attachment (a file attached to a message or a prompt): a 2px ink frame, a fine-framed media square, title in the reading face and description in small mono. States via state: done (rest), uploading (a running line along the bottom edge), processing (the manga Spinner in the media square), error (accent line, a mark-error '!' and accent description), idle (a solid line with a '+' mark). AttachmentTrigger makes the whole card clickable (hover-lift, focus ring); AttachmentAction is a small square ink button with hover-thicken. AttachmentGroup wraps. Sizes default, sm, xs; orientation horizontal or vertical.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/attachment`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `state`: `"idle" | "uploading" | "processing" | "error" | "done"` (default `"done"`) — The look of the file: running line, spinner, accent error or idle '+'.
  - `size`: `"default" | "sm" | "xs"` (default `"default"`) — Stock sizes, kept.
  - `orientation`: `"horizontal" | "vertical"` (default `"horizontal"`) — Vertical puts the media on top.

```tsx
import { Attachment, AttachmentMedia, AttachmentContent, AttachmentTitle, AttachmentDescription, AttachmentActions, AttachmentAction } from "@/components/ui/manga/attachment"

<Attachment state="uploading">
  <AttachmentMedia>…</AttachmentMedia>
  <AttachmentContent>
    <AttachmentTitle>page-12.png</AttachmentTitle>
    <AttachmentDescription>Uploading 64%</AttachmentDescription>
  </AttachmentContent>
  <AttachmentActions>
    <AttachmentAction aria-label="Remove">×</AttachmentAction>
  </AttachmentActions>
</Attachment>
```

### Marker (`marker`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Marker (a line inside a conversation, such as 'Today', 'Model switched to ...' or 'Context compacted'): lettering, small, uppercase, always ink (never grey). variant separator draws a 1px ink rule on both sides; variant border draws a 1px ink rule under it. Links inside take the underline hover and the focus ring. MarkerIcon stays in ink.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/marker`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `variant`: `"default" | "separator" | "border"` (default `"default"`) — separator: rules on both sides. border: a rule under the line.

```tsx
import { Marker, MarkerIcon, MarkerContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/marker"

<Marker variant="separator">
  <MarkerContent>Today</MarkerContent>
</Marker>
```

### Message Scroller (`message-scroller`)

Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Message Scroller (the scrolling column of a conversation with a 'jump to latest' button). The viewport keeps the stock behaviour (it scrolls) with a thin ink scrollbar and no grey fade at the edges. MessageScrollerButton is a square ink-framed button (only bubbles are round): it pops in when the reader scrolls up (animate-pop), lifts on hover, shows a focus ring and hits on click (impact lines). 44px touch target under 640px.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/message-scroller`
- Categories: display
- Props:
  - `direction`: `"start" | "end"` (default `"end"`) — Which way the button jumps: to the latest line or to the first.

```tsx
import { MessageScrollerProvider, MessageScroller, MessageScrollerViewport, MessageScrollerContent, MessageScrollerItem, MessageScrollerButton } from "@/components/ui/manga/message-scroller"

<MessageScrollerProvider>
```
